description:
Search claim statements and excerpts.

    Evidence strength orders the hits. When the query is one domain keyword,
    claims in that domain come first.

    Use this when you have keywords or a domain and want the strongest matching claims.
    Returns claim id, status, evidence strength, and a shortened excerpt.
    Example: query_claims(query="transformer", domain="ai-ml", limit=5).
    Example: query_claims(query="United States", domain="data-protection", limit=5).

ClaimFilters.description: Optional status, strength, and assertion type for a claim search.

assertion_type.description: Keep one assertion type: asserted, hedged, or conditional. Example: asserted.

min_strength.description: Drop claims below this evidence strength, from 0 to 1. Example: 0.6.
min_strength.title: Min Strength

status.description: Keep one status: consensus, contested, or outdated. Example: consensus.

ClaimFilters.title: ClaimFilters

domain.description: Restrict results to one domain. Example: ai-ml.
domain.title: Domain

filters.description: Optional status, minimum evidence strength, and assertion type. Example: {"status": "consensus", "min_strength": 0.6}.

offset.description: Number of hits to skip. Example: 0.
offset.title: Offset

query.description: Text matched against the claim statement and its excerpt. Example: transformer.
query.title: Query

name: query_claims
